description: Advisory checks for the inspected Mobkoi landing-tag 1.0.0 query sender on three exact engagement routes. The separate VAST impression, click and video collectors remain uncovered.

params.name: sdk_event
params.description: Path-derived sender branch. A query parameter cannot change the selected path branch.

params.name: deid
params.description: The inspected sender emits Date.now().toString(36) plus a base36 random suffix. This is a producer spelling check, without uniqueness, length, timestamp recovery or receiver acceptance claims.

params.name: iid
params.description: Opaque impression reference copied from mbiid or session storage. The serializer omits null/undefined values, and this pack does not invent receiver-side presence, value or account rules.

params.name: asp
params.description: Page-in-view sender copies location.href. Check a submitted absolute URL without requiring HTTPS, stripping query data or narrowing the scheme.

params.name: isl
params.description: The page-in-view sender serializes its Boolean landing flag as true or false. Other events do not inherit this field contract.

params.name: rt
params.description: The inspected page-in-view sender has three internal route branches. This is a version-scoped producer advisory rather than a closed receiver-wide event vocabulary.

params.name: top
params.description: The buffer sender serializes accumulated Date.now differences in milliseconds. Preserve zero, negative clock changes and exponent notation; do not impose a positivity, integer precision or session-duration bound.

params.name: sr
params.description: The inspected buffer sender has three internal flush reasons. The advisory applies only to this source profile.

params.name: method
params.description: Both navigator.sendBeacon(url) and the fallback fetch(url,{method:POST,keepalive:true}) use POST. No content-type, body, header or credentials requirement is inferred.
